description.value:
Coils of dark energy burst from you, lashing every creature within 10 feet. Each must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d6 necrotic damage and lose the ability to take reactions until its next turn; a successful save halves the damage and negates the other effect.

Cast with a slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 1
